## Appearance

Henry is an elderly man with a wizened face. He is further distinguished by his bright, old black eyes.

## History

Henry is a deceased local resident from [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) whose death is documented in an obituary. Miss Cornelia reads his obituary aloud to [Anne](../character/anne.md) during a visit to discuss neighborhood history and local news.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P1](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0001), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P6](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0006), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P9](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0009), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P10](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0010), +34 more_

## Relationships

### [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/henry--uncle-jim.md)

Henry and [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) are old cronies who previously sailed together aboard the Gray Gull. As longtime comrades and friends, they share a bond rooted in their shared seafaring history. Their connection represents an enduring friendship formed during their time at sea.
